Using information from a brain summary table, I will show the number of genes which are catagorised as regionally elevated in the **forebrain** this includes the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus. 
```{r}
Human_number<- sum(180,83,57,110)
print(paste("Humans have, in the forebrain,", Human_number, "elevated genes."))
```
```{r}
Pig_number<- sum(109,157,31,45)
print(paste("Pigs have, in the forebrain,", Pig_number, "elevated genes."))
```

```{r}
Mouse_number <- sum(55,185,60,98)
print(paste("Mice have, in the forebrain,", Mouse_number, "elevated genes."))
```
Therefore, 
Humans have the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
